lines.speaker: night_supervisor
lines.text: Nights. Somebody has to be allocated to an empty building and it has been me for six years.

lines.speaker: night_supervisor
lines.text: Your desk is still yours. Enforcement has been up four times and never once opened the drawer, because opening a drawer is not on anybody's work order.

lines.speaker: night_supervisor
lines.text: You cleared the gate drone at Kell village. That went round this office. Nobody said anything out loud and everybody knew by Thursday.

lines.speaker: night_supervisor
lines.text: You outran two on the valley road the night you left. I logged them as a maintenance excursion. It was the only interesting form I have filed in six years.
